lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Trump says he’s asked UFC’s Dana White to be his press secretary. No one will say if he’s joking, The Associated Press reports.
Aid sector calls out lack of any mention of foreign aid in federal budget, The Canadian Press reports.
Israel’s president has tapped opposition candidate Gadi Eisenkot to form a new government, in another setback for Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, The Associated Press reports.
US military says it fired on commercial vessel in Gulf of Oman after it attempted to breach blockade, The Associated Press reports.

A Polish man with far-right views drove into a busy central square in Krakow on Saturday and opened fire, killing six people and injuring 15 others before police shot and wounded him, authorities said.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
